name: ml_ranker_ew
description: PIT top-50 perps, 1d decisions: equal-weight composite of 23 pre-signed cross-sectional ranks (reversal, momentum, low vol, volume, taker flow, funding carry, crowd L/S, OI); long top-k / short bottom-k, dollar neutral, vol-targeted. No fitting.
mechanism: Diversified multi-factor composite: each factor is weak and fee-dominated alone; averaging ranks cancels much of their idiosyncratic noise while keeping turnover low (~60x/yr). About a third of the return is funding received (long negative-funding, short positive-funding).
frozen_rule: config with the best MEDIAN within-fold train rank across walk-forward folds (tie: mean train Sharpe)

implementability_200.note: round_to_qty=True with load_bybit_instruments() on the stitched OOS weights; dropped share is an estimate (orders whose |delta notional| < max(minNotionalValue, minOrderQty*price) at the unrounded equity).

expectancy_units: USD per closed round trip on the $200 OOS account

causality.plus_walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward causality_checks=2 per fold raised nothing)

caveats: Crowd-metric features exist for 53 coins from ~2021-12 (~60% of the tradable top-50); the top-trader ratio is NaN for most of 2022.
Labels of names that delist inside the label window are dropped from training (the sim still books the delisting close).
Live needs Binance public data (taker-buy volume, L/S ratios, funding) for ~50 names plus a Bybit symbol map.

Signs of the taker-flow (tb1, tb7 +) and crowd (zG -, D +) features were informed by phase-2 results on the SAME 2022-2025H1 dev data: those components are not a clean OOS test; see ablation_post_hoc (textbook-priors-only row).
This was pre-registered as the sanity BASELINE for the ML ranker, not as a strategy; promoting it after it won is itself a selection step (counted: 14 family-H trials).
live_retrain_cadence: none (no model); daily decision at the 00:07 UTC run on the closed 1d bar
bug_hunt: OOS Sharpe 1.44 (< 2). The FROZEN dev-period Sharpe 2.04 is driven by 2021 (+198%, Sharpe 4.6, alt-season dispersion) which is before the OOS window; 2022-2025 dev years 0.9-1.4 (2025H1 2.6).

No fitting, so no in-sample overfit of weights; but signs of tb/zG/D came from phase-2 on the same data. Ablation: the TEXTBOOK-priors-only composite (price reversal/momentum, low vol, volume, carry - no taker flow, no crowd metrics) has OOS-window Sharpe 1.46, so the result does not depend on the contaminated components. The price group alone gives 1.23; flow alone 1.21; risk, volume and carry alone are <= 0 (they help only as diversifiers or not at all: without_volume 1.59, without_carry 1.57 - post-hoc, NOT selected).
'only_crowd' shows 0: crowd metrics exist for ~30 of the top-50 names, below the 4k=40 minimum names the book requires, so it never trades.

Causality: walk-forward guard + 6 random cut checks passed. Extra 1-day decision lag: OOS Sharpe 1.30 (from 1.44). Sign-flip null p=0.010 (99.5th pct), random-timing runs null p=0.020 (null turnover 189 vs 211, not biased low).
Funding: +8.45%/yr of equity RECEIVED; no-funding OOS Sharpe 1.03 (~1/3 of return is carry-like).

Concentration: top-5 names = 51% of OOS P&L over 297 names (ALPACA $66 of $340 - its April-2025 pre-delisting pump; 2025-04-30 alone +11.4% on the book); ex-top-5 P&L is still +$166 on $200. Worst trade -92% of notional (INIT short, 2025-05), ~$2.6.
Long leg alone OOS Sharpe 0.36, short leg alone 0.63; mean net weight -0.001; daily corr to BTC -0.01.
Correlation to micro_flowxs 0.35 (frozen dev) / 0.38 (OOS books) - shares the taker-flow + funding exposure; ~0 to micro_crowd.
verdict_note: default family-E rule gives 'marginal': Sharpe 1.44, p 0.02, all 4 OOS years positive, but deflated Sharpe 0.84 (< 0.9) with 14 family-H trials (0.96 counting only its own 4 configs).
